script_text: Stop ignoring the quiet tension in your chart, Virgo—this week demands strategic precision. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury trines Pluto while activating your 10th House, fueling career breakthroughs through Tuesday morning. However, Wednesday afternoon shifts energy when Venus squares Saturn in your 7th House, triggering necessary boundary conversations with romantic partners. Thursday brings a decisive pivot as the Sun conjuncts your North Node across the 6th House, realigning daily workflows. Friday through Sunday, Jupiter sextiles your natal Mercury, accelerating financial audits while grounding your Earth element through disciplined routines. Use Sunday to reconcile joint accounts and plan wealth strategies. Tuesday is your power day because Venus stabilizes your income sector, maximizing freelance payouts. Wednesday is your worst day because lunar void periods across your 3rd sector disrupt clear communication. Ground Mercury’s sharp ruling logic by drafting all physical contracts twice before signing. Follow for daily updates.
